svg.text: Architecture & Workflow • single LLM agent (LangGraph) wrapped in a control surface
benchmark.yml: guardrail + control-API tests + 18-scenario benchmark (success-rate & CPSO gate) • escalation.yml: cron 10 min • keepalive.yml: pings simulator
B. LangGraph investigation loop (max 8 steps · $1 cost cap · 60 s latency cap)
every plan / observation step → traces table (Supabase)
dashboard buttons or Slack → Control API
pending approval too long → Slack escalation; p99 alert
runs 18 scenarios → success vs ground truth
gates CI on min success rate
